question: For any representation C proposed for TRUMP, do equal representation fibers preserve the target predicate, and if so is there also a polynomial decision procedure on the representation?

authority_lattice.semantic_authority: all fibers are monochromatic for the target predicate
authority_lattice.algorithmic_authority: semantic authority plus polynomial encoder, polynomial representation size, and a polynomial decider operating on the representation
authority_lattice.warning: a polynomial decoder or witness verifier alone does not imply a polynomial SAT decision procedure

QUARANTINED_INSUFFICIENT_REPRESENTATION_: one exact fiber collision with opposite SAT truth values is found

positive.name: EXACT_CANONICAL_CNF_IDENTITY
positive.purpose: gate sanity control; injective representation, not a claimed SAT compression

negative.name: CLV_RESOURCE_PROFILE
negative.purpose: prove that a useful resource profile must not be silently promoted to semantic decision authority

proof_lane: For a candidate C, prove universally that every C-fiber is SAT-monochromatic. Finite collision absence is calibration only and never a universal proof.
counterexample_lane: Search exact finite domains for x,y in the same C-fiber with opposite SAT truth values; one verified collision refutes predicate sufficiency for that C.
success_condition: The executable gate must grant semantic authority only to theorem-backed positive controls, must find and verify a SAT/UNSAT collision for the lossy CLV control, must quarantine that representation, and must preserve every P-vs-NP firewall.
